description: This file defines the class `EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator`, which implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface. It configures the menu for the 'My Attendance Record' view in the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding module and screen context to 'time' and 'viewMyAttendanceRecord'.

classes.name: EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for editing 'My Attendance Record' and overrides module and screen context to 'time' and 'viewMyAttendanceRecord'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the menu for the given screen by overriding the module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewMyAttendanceRecord'.
